description: A NEGATIVE fixture, and it is schema-invalid on purpose: 'edit' declares no 'is'. The loader has no opinion on it - FormKind.Unknown is C#'s zero - so the declaration passes and the schema stage refuses the file, which is the one thing here that is being pinned: a stage past the declaration failing, and the stages after it left unknown. Nothing else in it may break the schema, or the finding would be another one.
